data.name: Portal Time Traveller
data.detailed_description:
A Pawn in Time, or the Master of Your Own Destiny?

Within the cold walls of a mysterious laboratory, you are nothing but a number: Subject 247. Your mission is simple yet deadly; step through time portals to travel to different eras, collect specific objects commanded by the scientists, and bring them back to the lab. But what are these objects for? Are they truly for the salvation of humanity or part of a much darker plan?

Defying Orders is an Option!

In this atmospheric first-person adventure presented by ERY Games, you don't have to follow the rules imposed on you. You can simply do as you are told and remain an obedient subject or you can break beyond the confines of the lab and ignite your own rebellion across different timelines. Your choices will determine end of the story.

Four Different Eras, Unforgiving Trials As you fulfill your missions within shattered time, you will face unique rules of each era:

  • Primal Savagery: React to, hunt and survive against the most advanced prehistoric predators. In this atmospheric thriller, you can rely on your stealth and intelligence or fight fearlessly.

  • Dark Middle Ages: Transcend the boundaries of time and find yourself in midst of a dark medieval civilization ruled by ruthless barbarian kingdoms. Uncover the ancient secrets of colossal, mysterious castles rising in forgotten lands.

  • The Modern City: Forge your own path amidst the soulless concrete jungle and colossal skyscrapers. Will you blend into the darkness, becoming a silent ghost with flawless reflexes or will you crush every obstacle in your path with the sheer power of brute force?

  • Neon Dystopia: Navigate a futuristic Cyberpunk city ruled by dark streets, cyber technology, and corrupt systems.

In this universe where time is shattered, each era represents a new threat, each portal a different struggle for survival. On this relentless journey from primal savagery to a neon-lit, corrupt future, adapt to merciless rules of each era, transcend boundaries, and become master of broken time.

Add to your Wishlist now and prepare to shatter the boundaries of time!

data.short_description: As Subject 247 of a mysterious laboratory, you are tasked with stepping through time portals to retrieve requested artifacts. Hunt dinosaurs, survive empire of Middle Ages, gather critical materials in streets and navigate a neon lit dystopia. Will you obey scientists or start your own rebellion?

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-4590 or AMD Ryzen 3 1200
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 1060 (3GB) or AMD Radeon RX 580 (4GB)
  • DirectX: Version 11
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 10 / Windows 11 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i7-6700K or AMD Ryzen 5 3600
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce RTX 2060 or AMD Radeon RX 6600
  • DirectX: Version 12
